docs.title: Creating a new users
docs.text:
To create a new user, go to https://app.kwill.tech/ and click Register:

  1. Don't forget your password! I haven't implemented password recovery yet.
  2. You'll need an access code. Contact me to get one.
  3. Check your email for a verification code. Warning: don't close the verification window, or you'll need to contact me to manually verify your account.

docs.title: Creating aand editing an Organization
docs.text: The first thing you'll need to do is create an Organization.

docs.title: Terms of Use
docs.text:
Welcome to Kwill! By using our service, you agree to the following terms:

Use of the Service: Kwill is a non-commercial service provided "as is." You may use the service to create and manage letter-writing campaigns for non-commercial purposes only.

Privacy: We make every attempt to avoid collecting any personal information. We do not store or share any personal information beyond what is necessary to provide the service.

Acceptable Use: You agree not to use the service to harass, intimidate, bully, or demean others. You also agree not to use the service for any illegal or harmful purposes.

Termination: We reserve the right to terminate the service at any time, with or without cause.

Privacy Policy: We are committed to protecting your privacy. We attempt to collect no personal information beyond what is minimally necessary to provide the service. We do not share your information with any third parties.

docs.title: February 9, 2025
docs.text:
• Uploaded logos and favicons no longer randomly disappear
  • Social metadata is now consistently showing

docs.title: February 6, 2025
docs.text: • Create a new campaign by duplicating an existing one

docs.title: February 3, 2025
docs.text:
• Can now change campaign status: Pending ⇒ Live ⇒ Finished
  • Filter campaigns list by status and organization
  • Pending campaigns aren’t publicly visible (redirects you to a public Organization page)
  • Finished campaigns have a message indicating such, no longer generate letters, and offers a link to the organization page

docs.title: February 1, 2025
docs.text: • Optionally add multiple CC email addresses to letter campaigns

docs.title: January 26, 2025
docs.text:
Fixed the following bugs:

  • Links in campaign instructions not clickable
  • Users table not showing users
  • Letter tester is not working
  • Line breaks lost on email from iPhone
  • Need to HTML encode mailto: links

docs.title: January 19, 2025
docs.text:
• Refactored prompt generation to increase flexibility.
  • Created a “Letter Tester” page so you can more quickly test your prompts.
  • Improved user roles and permissions to support multiple simultaneous organizations.
  • Added metatags to public Campaign Letter pages to improve social sharing
  • Fixed numerous bugs.
